criteria.text: Clinical or laboratory confirmation of HoFH diagnosis submitted
Box Warnings discussed with recipient and all relevant lab work monitored
For females of reproductive potential, a negative pregnancy test obtained
Medical records document low-fat diet supplying <20% of energy from fat prior to initiation
Recipient is 18 years of age or older

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid Juxtapid (lomitapide), shared Juxtapid OR Kynamro criteria Version 1; last updated 10/14/2013; Approved 11/15/2013. Stub effective_date 1970-01-01 preserved as a placeholder; the PDF documents approval, not an effective date.

Indicated as an adjunct to a low-fat diet and other lipid-lowering treatments, including LDL apheresis where available, for HoFH. Safety and effectiveness in patients without HoFH have not been established; effect on cardiovascular morbidity and mortality has not been determined.

Approval criteria 1–6 encoded as closed HoFH indication, clinical or laboratory confirmation submitted, Box Warnings discussion and relevant lab monitoring, current treatments submitted, negative pregnancy test for females of reproductive potential, documented pre-initiation diet with <20% energy from fat, and age ≥18. No additional denial criteria invented.
Duration (notes only): initial authorization up to 6 months; continuation up to 12 months with medical records documenting tolerance, progress notes, and effectiveness of therapy.
Quantity (notes only): 30 day supply; 5mg or 10mg one (1) capsule per day; 20mg up to three (3) capsules per day. max_units is null; quantity enforcement requires manual review.

Remains partial: submitted confirmation, counseling, laboratory monitoring, current treatments, pregnancy testing and diet documentation are attestations; evidence verification, duration, continuation and quantities require manual review. Kynamro is a linked alternative from the shared PDF and remains text_only; next candidate kynamro.
